title: Total RNA Purification from Plasma or Serum
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f5hbq36

steps.title: Prepare Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 200 μL of plasma or serum to a 1.5mL RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Lyse Sample
steps.instruction: Add 300 μL of Lysis Buffer RX for every 100 μL of plasma or serum used.

steps.title: Add MS2 RNA (Optional)
steps.instruction: Add 0.7μL of 0.8μg/μL MS2 RNA per sample if required for downstream consistency (e.g., real-time PCR or RT-PCR).

steps.title: Add Ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 400 μL of 96-100% ethanol to every 400 μL of lysate (equivalent to every 100μL plasma or serum used).

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Assemble an ISOLATE II RNA Column (black ring) with a provided Collection Tube and apply the ethanolic lysate.

substeps.instruction: Apply up to 600μL of the ethanolic lysate onto the column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at ≥ 3,500 x g.
Inspect the column to ensure the entire lysate volume has passed into the Collection Tube; if not, spin for an additional minute at 14,000 x g.
Discard the flow-through and reassemble the spin column with its Collection Tube.
Repeat these steps as required depending on the total lysate volume.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Perform three consecutive ethanol washes to purify the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: Apply 400 μL of 96-100% ethanol, centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 x g, discard flow-through, and reassemble.
Wash 2: Apply 400 μL of 96-100% ethanol, centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 x g, discard flow-through, and reassemble.
Wash 3: Apply 400 μL of 96-100% ethanol, centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 x g, discard flow-through, and reassemble.
Note: For each wash, if the buffer has not fully passed through, spin for an additional minute at 14,000 x g.

steps.title: Dry Column
steps.instruction: Spin the column for 2 min at 14,000 x g to dry it thoroughly, then discard the Collection Tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA into a fresh 1.7mL Elution Tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the column into a fresh 1.7mL Elution Tube.
Add 50μL of RNA Elution Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 200 x g.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 x g.
If the entire 50 μL has not been eluted, spin at 14,000 x g for an additional minute.

steps.title: Maximize Recovery (Optional)
steps.instruction: To increase RNA recovery or concentration, choose one of the following options:

substeps.instruction: For maximum recovery: Apply a second volume of RNA Elution Buffer and elute into the same tube.
For high concentration: Re-apply the first eluate onto the column and re-elute into the same tube.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the isolated RNA at -20°C for a few days or at -80°C (recommended) for long-term storage.
